seo.title: Strategic Mid-Career Transition | From Reflection to Results
seo.description: Evidence-led coaching for experienced professionals returning to work or switching fields. Turn your 'gap' into a strategic advantage with field-hardened guidance.

hero.title: A Laboratory for Results, Not Just Reflection
intro: Rebuilding professional momentum after a career break or relocation requires more than just self-discovery; it requires operational evidence and strategic positioning.
We don't just talk about your past; we translate it into the high-stakes language that UK hiring managers and stakeholders respect.

cards.title: Narrative Gap Friction
body: Struggling to articulate years of seniority when the recent CV gap feels like it's pulling you back. How to lead with your peak experience, not your latest pause.

cards.title: High-Stakes Interview Execution
body: Your skills haven't faded, but the 'delivery' in interviews needs to be recalibrated for the sharp, evidence-heavy UK recruitment style.

cards.title: Strategic Market Alignment
body: Ensuring you don't 'under-sell' yourself out of survival fear, and instead hold position for roles that match your true 15+ years value.

cards.title: Operational Evidence Portfolio
body: Identify the 'unspoken proof' in your history and turn it into clear, strategic case studies you can deploy during networking.

cards.title: The Rehearsal Lab
body: We don't just 'talk about' interviews; we rehearse them. Get honest, high-level feedback on your impact and bilingual switching rhythm.

cards.title: Momentum & Boundary Protocols
body: Design a job search cadence that mirrors high-level project management—ensuring results without letting the search consume your family life.

sections.title: Results in Action
body: “R” had managed teams across Asia before a 2-year relocation break. In her coaching 'Lab', we moved past the 'guilt' of the gap and focused on her previous management of 100+ people. We rehearsed a specific 15-minute 'Strategic Contribution' pitch for executive recruiters. Within four sessions, she secured a post-relocation role at a Tier-1 consultancy, using her gap as evidence of her 'calculated risk-taking' and emotional intelligence—a strategic asset rather than a liability.

sections.title: Ready for a Result-Oriented Change?
body: Book a 20-minute strategic consultation. We'll move past general advice and start mapping your operational return.
